description.narrative: The CBRN Preparedness Program (CP2) is U.S. Department of Defense's premier program for developing partner nation Weapons of Mass Destruction(WMD)/Chemical, Biological, Radiological, or Nuclear (CBRN) preparedness and emergency response capabilities across all levels of government (tactical to strategic). This program trains and equips partners to prevent, protect against, mitigate, respond to, and recover from WMD/CBRN incidents. All program activities directly support CCMD Theater Campaign Plan Objectives, Guidance for Employment of Forces End States, Secretary of Defense Strategy for Countering WMD, and the Presidents Priorities for the 21st Century Defense. Program activities decrease the need for U.S. assets to deploy in support of partner nations, reduce the amount of resources when support is required, and enhance the interoperability of U.S. and partner forces.
